description: Mark an authorized spend as failed when the action did not succeed (e.g. payment processor declined, API error). This releases the reserved funds back to the budget so they can be used again.

error_message.description: Optional human-readable error detail for the audit log.

reason.description: Short reason code for the failure (e.g. 'PAYMENT_DECLINED', 'API_ERROR', 'TOOL_ERROR').

name: figuard_fail
